blocking_factors: Disk at 95.2 percent would cross into macOS critical zone post-install
RAM available (2.03 GB) is below the 2-4 GB peak required by marker-pdf + surya-ocr inference; runtime would thrash swap
No headroom for concurrent work in a dev session
unblockers_required: Free at least 15 GB of disk (target 20 percent free) before any install
Close background memory consumers to free at least 4 GB RAM for inference, OR move ML inference to a different machine with 16 GB+ RAM
Alternatively: use lighter PDF parsing alternatives that already ship (docling from Sprint WIKI + ocrmypdf 17.4.1 already installed)
decision_gate.notes: The expected finding from plan-write time (marker-pdf + surya-ocr are heavy ML libs that stress an 8 GB M2) has been empirically confirmed with real numbers. Deferring until either the environment is freed up or a different target machine is available. Tranche 2 will be scoped to what can ship on current deps — ProcessPoolExecutor parallelism (stdlib), OCRPreprocessor wrapping ocrmypdf (already installed), and a Golden Corpus benchmark harness (no new deps).
